class.name: MaszynaTrackData
class.description: What the core's [TrackData] says, and what MaSzyna's format adds: how the track is drawn ([MaszynaTrackRenderingBackend], named by [method TrackData.get_rendering_backend]), its quality and its surroundings for the running sound (in [member TrackData.meta] under [enum MetaKey]), its events. Saved in the compiled scenery's cache by its class name.

members.member: The events the track names for each of its slots, by the slot's key: a slot may name several, every [code]event2 <name>[/code] line one more ([code]Track.cpp:815-858[/code]).
The track's length as the .scn gives it [m].
The rails' texture - a road's surface; empty for none.
The trackbed's texture - a switch's diverging rails, a road's sides; empty for none.
The .scn's other keywords of the track: [code]trackbed[/code], [code]isolated[/code], [code]friction[/code] (a memory cell).
The rail profile the rails are drawn with ([code]models/tory/railprofile_<name>.txt[/code]).
The trackbed's height under the rails, a road's shoulder drop; below 0 a road's curb [m].
The length the textures cover along the track [m], unless the material gives its own.
The width of the trackbed's slope, a road's shoulder slope or right sidewalk [m].
The width of the trackbed's crown beyond the rails, a road's shoulder or left sidewalk [m].

constants.constant: A name the original does not know ([code]Track.cpp:474-477[/code]).
The key of [member TrackData.meta] holding the track's [enum MaszynaEnvironmentType].
The key of [member TrackData.meta] holding the track's quality, for its running sound.
